product_brief: Hardware module providing network and secure communications functionality to facilitate propagation of keys between nodes and endpoint clients in a Phio Hive.
pqc_capability_description: PQC is an optional feature used for redundant communications channel obfuscation. It is excluded from the cryptographic boundary and FIPS 140-3 requirements. No specific PQC algorithms are listed.
crypto_primitives: AES-CBC, AES-ECB, AES-GCM, Counter DRBG, DSA KeyGen, ECDSA KeyGen, ECDSA SigGen, ECDSA SigVer, HMAC-SHA-1, HMAC-SHA2-256, HMAC-SHA2-384, KAS-ECC-SSC, KAS-FFC-SSC, KDF SSH, RSA SigGen, RSA SigVer, SHA-1, SHA2-256, SHA2-384, SHA2-512, TLS v1.2 KDF
key_management_model: Key propagation between Phio TX nodes and endpoint clients in a Phio Hive (dynamic peer network); supports ETSI and SKIP REST services for key exchange; uses KAS-ECC-SSC and KAS-FFC-SSC for key agreement.
license: Proprietary (requires valid Phio TX License for Approved mode enforcement)
fips_validated: Yes, FIPS 140-3 Level 2 (Certificate #4850, Active, Sunset Date 10/22/2029)
implementation_attack_surface: Non-invasive security level 2; physical security level 2; mitigates other attacks level N/A; excludes TPM, whole disk encryption, PQC, QRNG, and password hash from cryptographic boundary.
testing_&_validation_methods: CAVP tested (A2983); ACVP conformance; Conditional Self-Tests (CASTs); Firmware integrity tests (txscan); Approved Algorithms tested per FIPS 140-3.
qrng_&_entropy_sources: Optional QRNG hardware option (Phio TX-Q) used as additional entropy input; not credited in DRBG seeding strength rationale; ENT (NP) entropy source used to seed approved DRBG.
supply_chain_&_vendor_risk: Vendor: Quantum Xchange; Prepared by KeyPair Consulting Inc.; Lab: Acumen Security.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Requires installation of valid Phio TX License with locked Approved mode enforcement; does not support non-Approved or degraded mode; no manual key entry supported.
